about.body: The AJD-V6 is a V6 (60° angle), 2.7L (2,720 cc) / 3.0L, Diesel engine used across Jaguar's 3 model range, in production 2003–2015. We rebuild every AJD-V6 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The AJD-V6 is fitted across S-Type, XF, XJ — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the AJD-V6 is fitted across multiple Jaguar models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
